CrudApi, Thumbnailer and Compression show normal REPORT lines with no errors. No alarms are active. The bucket name is not visible in the logs and I could not read the live function configuration or the IaC template, so the candidates are inferred from the error. The single HTTP 403 at 13:29Z is an isolated event outside the window and is not the cause.
